overview: Scoping review following JBI methods, reported with PRISMA-ScR, charting how preoperative anaemia pathways for elective hip and knee replacement are organised and how they reach distant patients.
population: Reports of pathways for adults awaiting elective hip or knee replacement, 2010 to 2026, including journal articles, service evaluations, guidelines and hospital reports.
exposure: Any organised pathway for detecting and treating anaemia before elective joint replacement.
procedures: Librarian-designed search of three databases, two guideline repositories and hospital and health system websites; two residents screen independently and chart with a piloted form (screening point, triggers, lead, treatments and location, times, postponements, communication, provisions for distant patients); disagreements resolved with the anaesthesiologist lead; results presented in tables and a pathway diagram.

outcomes.name: Screening point and time before surgery
outcomes.measure: Charted screening point and reported days from screening to surgery
outcomes.why: The pathway feature that sets the treatment window (claim c1).

outcomes.name: Referral triggers and ownership
outcomes.measure: Charted haemoglobin and ferritin thresholds and named owner

outcomes.name: Access for distant patients
outcomes.measure: Charted outreach, community infusion or single-visit options and reported travel
outcomes.why: Added after the revised gaps (claim c4).

outcomes.name: Reporting completeness
outcomes.measure: Proportion of reports describing a reproducible pathway
outcomes.why: Existing reports are often incomplete (claim c3).

feasibility: About 120 resident hours: 20 for screening pilots, 60 for dual screening, 30 for charting and 10 for tables.
biasMitigation: Charting form piloted on five reports
Leads from the discovery reply checked by identifier before inclusion

biasFlags.label: Publication bias toward successful pathways
biasFlags.note: Grey literature and hospital reports searched.

biasFlags.label: Incomplete reporting
biasFlags.note: Missing items charted as not reported, never inferred.

parsimony.simplestPath: One search, one charting form, descriptive tables.

theoreticalFramework: JBI scoping review methodology; no additional framework.
summary: JBI scoping review with a fixed charting form including access for distant patients.
